Nagmistulang isang mahabang parking lot ang palibot ng Quezon City Memorial Circle dahil sa dami ng motorsiklo ng mga rider na kukuha ng cash assistance mula sa DSWD ngayong araw, April 19.

Sa video kuha kaninang 7:30 AM, makikita na halos nasakop na rin ng mga naka-park na motorsiklo ang isang lane. May mga nagmamando naman na traffic enforcer at nagbabantay na awtoridad sa palibot ng circle.

Bisitahin ang https://t.co/KqDTBMbTQD para sa iba pang updates.

data.raw_text:
𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐬: 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞’𝐬 𝐂𝐨𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐆𝐮𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 🌿🌊

Mangroves are among nature’s most effective coastal protectors—serving as biodiversity lifelines, natural storm barriers, and key players in climate change mitigation. Their dense root systems slow floodwaters, absorb wave energy, reduce storm surges, trap sediments, and stabilize shorelines, helping protect communities and ecosystems.

However, mangroves loss increases costal exposure. Damages to residential and industrial property could rise by 28 percent (over $1 billion annually) with about 766 km of roads at risk of flooding. Without these natural defenses, storm surges can travel farther inland, heightening risks to lives, livelihoods, and ecosystems, particularly in Southeast Asian countries such as the Philippines.

In the Philippines, mangrove forests have declined significantly over the past century. Since 1918, the Philippines’ mangrove cover has down to 284,798 hectares or over 64 percent loss, largely due to large-scale conversion to aquaculture ponds, coastal development, and unsustainable resource use.

Aligned with the Philippine Development Plan (PDP) 2023-2028, the government will strengthen the enabling environment for private sector engagement in mitigation, promote the development of green technologies, and implement transformative policies and actions to curb greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.

The government will also prioritize action based on the mitigation hierarchy that lead to the best outcomes for communities and the environment. Hence, transitioning to a low-carbon economy will involve strengthening adaptation actions with high mitigation potential, including restoring and protecting terrestrial and blue carbon ecosystems such as mangroves and seagrasses.

#EarthDay2026
